## Where to start

1. **Starting a project?** Read [Start a project with the toolkit](./how-to/start-a-project.md).
2. **Building one effect?** Find it in [How-tos](./how-to/README.md).
3. **Reviewing work?** Run down [the twelve rules](./rules/README.md).
4. **Looking for ideas?** Read a [case study](./cases/README.md), then browse [/sites](/sites).
